meta.title: Pay an invoice · Candy Heist
meta.description: Pay the other half of a commission with Candy Heist, with the invoice ID from your email.

find.label: Pay an invoice
find.heading: The other half
find.sub: When your commission is ready, Candy emails you an invoice for the rest. Enter its ID to pay it.

field.label: Invoice ID
field.placeholder: As it appears in the email

pay.sub: The other half of your commission, due now it’s ready.

paid.body: That’s the rest of your commission settled. Your receipt is on its way to your email.
